info.name: World News Extract News Search News API

params.name: text
params.description: The keyword(s) to search for in the news article text.

params.name: source-country
params.description: The ISO 3166 country code of the news source (e.g. "us", "gb").

params.name: language
params.description: The ISO 6391 language code of the news (e.g. "en").

params.name: categories
params.description: A comma-separated list of categories to filter by (e.g. politics, sports, business, technology, entertainment, health, science, lifestyle, travel, culture, education, environment, other).

params.name: entities
params.description: Semantic filter for specific people, organizations, or locations, e.g. "ORG:Tesla,PER:Elon Musk,LOC:Berlin".

params.name: location-filter
params.description: Filter news by radius around a location, formatted as "latitude,longitude,radius-in-km" where the radius is between 1 and 100 km. Example - news within 15 km of London - "51.509865,-0.118092,15". This powers local and geo news search.

params.name: earliest-publish-date
params.description: The news must have been published after this date (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

params.name: latest-publish-date
params.description: The news must have been published before this date (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

params.name: sort-direction
params.description: Whether to sort ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC).

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of news items to skip, for pagination (default 0).

params.name: number
params.description: The number of news items to return, up to 100 (default 10).

items.docs: Search and filter news by keyword, semantic entities, category, language, source country, publish-date range, and geographic location. The `location-filter` parameter enables local news search by drawing a radius (1-100 km) around a latitude/longitude point, so consumers can find news mentioning or published near a specific place.
